summary: Short focused frontend run of the Happiness Trading flipbook reader (PDF not tested, per request). Everything requested passed: desktop cover and flipping, TOC jumps (bab-5 opens a spread showing page-number-38 and chapter-opener-5; author profile works), Quiz part 1 (clicking options did not flip the page, score was 3/3), reflection text saved after reload, and the mobile single-page view with a toolbar that does not overflow.

issues: Some pages are fully blank apart from a small center ornament (e.g. page 37 left of chapter 5 opener, page 1 after cover). Acceptable as book-style blank versos, but on mobile single-page view this looks like an empty screen.

action_items: Optional: consider skipping or hiding decorative blank verso pages in mobile portrait mode
critical_code_review_comments: Reader.jsx: current page restored from localStorage without validation against NaN (Number('abc') -> NaN) - minor robustness
context_for_next_testing_agent: Book has 127 pages. toc-link-quiz-1 jumps to spread 31-32; q2 of quiz part 1 is on page 33, reflection page 34. localStorage keys: ht-page, ht-quiz. PDF download not tested in this run.
